**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Soft Tissues,* pages 157-161.
* Primary sites C490-C496, C498, and C499 are listed in the chapter heading but are not specified in the anatomic subsites in this chapter of the UICC manual; however, they are included in this schema and TNM staged if appropriate histology criteria are met
* For soft tissue sarcomas of the heart and mediastinum (C380-C383, C388) use the Heart, Mediastinum schema
* For soft tissue sarcomas of the retroperitoneum (C480), use the Retroperitoneum schema
* For soft tissue sarcomas of the peritoneum (C481-C482, C488), use the Peritoneum schema

**Note 2:**  Laterality must be coded for C471-C472 and C491-C492.

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Peripheral Nerves & Autonomic Nervous System: Connective, Subcutaneous & Other Tissues* chapter on page 184 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=184).
